summary: The single web page that starts the Capital Projects app by loading its code into an empty container.
purpose: Gives the browser the page frame, the sharing details, the site icon, the fonts, and the link to the main app script.
why: Likely reason: a single page app normally uses one empty container that its code fills in.
how: 1. Set the character set and screen size. 2. Set the sharing title, description, and image. 3. Load the site icon and Google fonts. 4. Provide an empty root container. 5. Load the main app script as a module.
inputs: The static icon at /favicon.png, Google Fonts, and the script at src/main.tsx.
outputs: A page with an empty root element, which the script fills with the app.
risks: The sharing image and handle point to replit, which appear to be template leftovers, so shared links may show the wrong brand.
debug: If the page is blank, check the browser console for a failed script load, confirm src/main.tsx exists, and confirm the root element is still present. If fonts look wrong, check the Google Fonts link.
